page.explain_password_register: Choose a password with at least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}. We will email a token to verify your address before creating the account.
page.explain_password_login: Enter your email address and password.
page.explain_token: We will email you a single-use token. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
page.explain_code: We will email you a six-digit code and a single-use token. They expire in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
page.code_or_token_label: Code or token from the email
page.passkey_register_explain: Create the passkey first; we then email a token to verify your address. The account and its passkey exist once you enter that token above.
page.noscript_login: Email and account management require JavaScript. Provider sign-in works without it.
page.send_delivered_code: Send a code to my verified contact
page.passkeys_explain: Sign in again before changing passkeys. To remove one, sign in through another login method.
page.mfa_explain: Sign in again before changing these settings. Enrollment, disabling two-factor authentication and replacing recovery codes sign out all sessions.
page.recovery_explain: Save these recovery codes privately. Each works once and they are shown only now.
page.set_password_explain: First sign in using a fresh email token. Changing your password signs out every other session.
page.change_password_explain: Changing your password signs out every other session.
page.change_email_explain_approval: Sign in again first. Approve the change with the token sent to your current address, then confirm the token sent to your new address, both in this session. Confirming signs out all sessions.
page.change_email_explain: Sign in again first. Confirm the token sent to your new address in this session. Confirming signs out all sessions.
page.delete_explain: This permanently deletes your account. Sign in again first, then enter your current email to confirm.
page.linked_providers_explain: To unlink a provider, first sign in again using another method. Unlinking signs out all sessions.

client.signed_in: You are signed in. You can now manage your account.
client.enter_code_email: Enter the email address the code was sent to.
client.provider_unlinked: Provider unlinked. You are signed out. Sign in using your remaining method.
client.email_changed: Email changed. You are signed out. Sign in using your new address.
client.press_approve: Press Approve change to allow the new address.
client.press_confirm: Press Confirm new email to finish the change.
client.password_saved: Password saved. Other sessions have been signed out.
client.verify_mfa: Verify your second factor to finish signing in.
client.code_sent: Code sent to your verified contact. Choose Delivered code above.
client.no_passkeys: This browser does not support passkeys.
client.passkey_removed: Passkey removed. Sign in again using another method.
client.scan_key: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter this key: {key}
client.enter_key: Enter this key in your authenticator app: {key}
client.check_contact: Check your verified contact for the code.
client.confirm_to_enable: Confirm the code to enable two-factor authentication.
client.mfa_enabled: Two-factor authentication enabled. Save your recovery codes, then sign in again.
client.recovery_replaced: Old recovery codes replaced. Save your recovery codes, then sign in again.
client.mfa_disabled: Two-factor authentication disabled. Sign in again.
client.device_forgotten: Device forgotten. Existing sessions can be revoked below.

error.unauthorized: That did not work. Check the code or token and try again, or sign in again.
error.forbidden: This was refused. Reload the page and try again.
error.not_found: That could not be found. Reload the page and try again.
error.invalid: That was not accepted. Check what you entered and try again.
error.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
error.validation: Check what you entered and try again.
error.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.unsupported_media_type: The server could not read the request. Reload the page and try again.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again later.
error.password_unchanged: Choose a new password that differs from your current one.
error.password_common: That password is too common or has appeared in a breach. Choose another.
error.password_length: Choose a password with at least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
error.password_too_long: Choose a password with at most {count, number, integer} UTF-8 bytes.
error.email_mismatch: Enter your current email address to confirm.
error.email_taken: That email address is not available.
error.passkey_limit: You already have the most passkeys an account can hold.
error.passkey_name: Give the passkey a name of up to 100 characters.
error.provider_linked: That provider account is already linked to an account.
error.credential_too_large: The passkey response was too large.
error.group_required: Choose where to sign in before continuing.

message.token_sent: Check your email for a sign-in token.
message.signup_token_sent: Check your email for a token to finish creating your account.
message.approval_sent: Check your current email address for an approval token.
message.confirmation_sent: Check your new email address for a confirmation token.
